phases.title: Pre-collection setup

phases.name: Check the rules

steps.label: Check what your funder, journal and institution expect
steps.prompt: What do my funder, journal and institution expect me to do with my data?
steps.text: Check funder, journal and institutional data sharing policies

steps.label: Spot any sensitive information in your data
steps.prompt: Help me find out whether my data hold any sensitive information.
steps.text: Identify sensitive data

steps.prompt: Help me decide how to protect the sensitive information in my data.
steps.text: Handle sensitive data

steps.label: Decide whether to delay public release

steps.text: Confirm whether an embargo is required

steps.label: Check your plans match your Data Management Plan

phases.summary: Find out what your funder, journal and institution require, and how your data must be protected.
phases.title: Governance and constraints

phases.name: Choose where to share

steps.prompt: Do I have to deposit my data in a particular repository?

steps.prompt: Help me choose a repository for my data.
steps.text: Recommend a repository where none is mandated

steps.prompt: How will my data get a permanent identifier, such as a DOI?
steps.text: Confirm or arrange persistent identifier (PID) assignment

steps.prompt: Who will be able to access my data in the repository, and what will depositing cost?

steps.text: Verify repository certification

phases.summary: Pick a repository that suits your data and meets those requirements.

steps.label: Tidy and version your files

steps.text: Clean and version the data files

steps.text: Recommend open formats

steps.label: Write a README and a data dictionary
steps.prompt: Help me write a README and a data dictionary for my data.

steps.label: Choose the metadata standard to follow
steps.prompt: Which metadata standard should I follow for my data?
steps.text: Identify the appropriate metadata standard

steps.label: Confirm the standard terms you will use
steps.prompt: Help me confirm the standard terms to use, now that I know what my repository needs.
steps.text: Finalise controlled vocabularies and ontologies

steps.label: Fill in the description of your dataset
steps.prompt: Help me fill in the description of my dataset.
steps.text: Complete metadata fields with FAIR-aligned, discipline-appropriate vocabularies and ontologies

phases.summary: Tidy the files and describe them so others can understand and reuse them.
phases.title: Data preparation and metadata creation

phases.name: Deposit your data

steps.label: Check the description is complete and correct
steps.prompt: Help me check that the description of my dataset is complete and correct.
steps.text: Validate metadata quality

steps.label: Choose a licence
steps.prompt: Help me choose a licence for my data.
steps.text: Assign a licence

steps.prompt: Help me check how FAIR my dataset's description is before I submit it.

steps.text: Set access restrictions

steps.label: Create a private link for peer reviewers

steps.label: Upload your files

steps.label: Review and submit
steps.prompt: Help me review my deposit before I submit it.
steps.text: Review and finalise the submission

phases.summary: Check the description, set the licence and access, and submit.
phases.title: Deposit and submit

steps.prompt: Help me check how FAIR the record of my published data is.

steps.prompt: Help me improve the description of an older dataset.
steps.text: Retrofit FAIR-aligned metadata for existing datasets

steps.label: Connect your data to related publications and datasets
steps.prompt: Help me connect my data to related publications and datasets.
steps.text: Link datasets to related research outputs

phases.summary: Follow how your data are used and keep their records up to date.
